## [HANNE NIELSEN & BIRGIT JOHNSEN – A Matter of Balance](https://xn--sorkunstmuseum-sqb.dk/en/udstillinger/hanne-nielsen-birgit-johnsen-a-matter-of-balance-2/ "HANNE NIELSEN & BIRGIT JOHNSEN – A Matter of Balance")

[![](https://xn--sorkunstmuseum-sqb.dk/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/a-matter-of-balance-26-still-1mindre-768x432.jpg)](https://xn--sorkunstmuseum-sqb.dk/en/udstillinger/hanne-nielsen-birgit-johnsen-a-matter-of-balance-2/)

The exhibition HANNE NIELSEN & BIRGIT JOHNSEN – A Matter of Balance showcases the wide-ranging scope of the artistic duo Hanne Nielsen and Birgit Johnsen’s innovative work in video art and media experimentation over more than 30 years.
